'''Mehtan''' was a [[Seanchan]] military clerk working in Captain Faloun's office in [[Almizar]], [[Amadicia]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mehtan}} He was young, smooth-faced and looked like he might have come from the [[Two Rivers]] to [[Perrin]]'s eyes.

==Activities==
When Perrin and Banner-General [[Tylee Khirgan]] went to Almizar to claim some [[raken]], he died by spewing tiny black beetles.

His death causes some discontentment among Perrin's followers.

He is to be entombed ceremonially, since he "died in service", as [[Blasic Faloun]], his disciplinarian, puts it.
